auditor.credentials: Child Psychologist & Certified Digital Child Safety Officer
auditor.organization: Independent Child Wellbeing & Digital Safety Council

safetyEvaluations.requirement: Audio output must not exceed 65 dB SPL to protect developing auditory systems.
safetyEvaluations.finding: All synthesized and pre-recorded phonics/voice cues normalized to 58-62 dB SPL.

safetyEvaluations.requirement: Zero fear triggers, monster visuals, aggressive sounds, or loss-framing language.
safetyEvaluations.finding: Content utilizes gentle pastel tones, friendly animal emojis (puppy, duck, frog), and warm encouraging voice prompts.

safetyEvaluations.requirement: Strict 15-minute continuous screen interaction hard stop.
safetyEvaluations.finding: EarlyChildhoodContentGuard terminates interactive sessions at 15.0m; requires compulsory 10-minute rest.

safetyEvaluations.requirement: Zero in-app purchases, zero monetization, zero streak loss anxiety, zero countdown urgency timers.
safetyEvaluations.finding: Hard technical filters verify complete absence of dark pattern lexemes and monetization hooks.

safetyEvaluations.requirement: Continuous real-time supervisory bridge for accompanying guardian.
safetyEvaluations.finding: Parent Co-Pilot terminal provides live audio transcript mirroring and immediate unilateral pause/kill switch.
